description: This file contains a test suite for the EventEmitter class, specifically testing the maximum listener count behavior.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: A class that manages event registration and emission, allowing multiple listeners per event.

methods.name: setMaxListeners
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of listeners for a particular event, with validation for non-negative values.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a new listener callback for a specified event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Triggers all listeners associated with a specific event.
